title: target-status/v1
description: targets/<id>/status/<date>-<n>.yaml (F03-Q5): a curator's signed target-level declaration — the D-33 status, whether the target is claimable (D-6: listed until fidelity reaches back-translated and the D-10 posting is made), its D-9 fidelity grade, and which node is the root when the DAG has more than one sink. Latest by date, then file name, wins; with no record a target is listed and not claimable unless its root is the tutorial (D-27). Dormancy declarations (D-33) are these records with status dormant.

cause.description: reasoning and, for dormancy, the D-25 series values at declaration
